stories.title: Construction Simulator: Evolution - Official Demolition Feature Gameplay Overview Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: Get a deep dive into the demolition gameplay feature of Construction Simulator: Evolution in this latest trailer for the next game in the Construction Simulator game series. In this new video, make your way to an old industrial site on the US-inspired map and learn about different materials and how to tackle them with specific machinery.In Construction Simulator: Evolution, you will be able to use officially licensed machines and suitable attachments from both new and returning licensing partners. These include the SENNEBOGEN 670 E equipped with a wrecking ball, the hydraulic Combi Cutter CC 1600 U with universal jaws from Epiroc, and a handheld demolition hammer from Wacker Neuson. With demolition, Construction Simulator: Evolution expands the familiar construction site experience with an entirely new phase of work. You'll take on contracts that require you to dismantle existing structures before the site can be transformed. And demolition isn't simply about hitting a building until it disappears. In this new trailer, journey to an old industrial site in Amber Falls, a US-inspired map, where an existing complex needs to make way for something new.Construction Simulator: Evolution will be available in PC Early Access, with PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S to follow.

stories.title: Dune: Awakening’s Single-Player Mode Will Keep You Busy Till Dune Part 3 | gamescom 2026 - IGN
stories.summary: Players have been exploring the desert planet of Arrakis on PC now for the past year, but Dune Awakening is finally headed to consoles in a big way. Launching with a long-requested single player mode, adapting story beats from the final chapter of book one in the Dune series, we couldn’t wait to sit down with Creative Director Joel Bylos to find out more! We chat changes from PC to console, how community feedback has shaped Dune Awakening, potential ties to the movie series and how to balance the feedback and expectations of players who want different experiences from the game. Dune Awakening launches September 22nd for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

stories.title: Amphibian - Official Announcement Trailer - IGN
stories.summary: Get a peek at classes, combat, enemies, and more in this Amphibian announcement trailer for the upcoming story-driven, frog-based, Super2D RPG.  Amphibian will be available on PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2028.A countrywide drought forces Sapo and his frog allies into war against the invading toads. As dehydration and starvation grip The Pond, they must hurry to find a solution to the crisis - and liberate their homeland. Dive into a focused, concise experience with fully curated battles and no random encounters, inspired by classic, turn-based RPGs from the era of GameCube and Game Boy Advance.
